name: @albertoriorda95/trajectory-proto
description: TypeScript types of the Protobuf messages of agent-team-demo-e2e, generated from proto/ with protobuf-es.

scripts.check-generated: test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src/gen)" || { echo "src/gen is not in step with proto/: run npm run generate and commit it" >&2; git status --porcelain -- src/gen >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check-generated && vitest run
